content: The room "{{roomName}}" will be permanently deleted. All data and user accesses will be lost.

comment.text: This is the confirmation message displayed in a dialog when a user attempts to delete a room. It informs the user that the room, identified by `{{roomName}}`, and all its associated data and user accesses will be permanently lost.
